title: Baimiao (Plain Line Drawing in Traditional Ink and Brush Style)

verification.verification_notes: Reference-work entry confirms baimiao as an unembellished plain-line descriptive register in Chinese art and narrative; appraised via further scholarly and technical sources that group it with gongbi, xieyi, and mogu. Treated as a concept-level source, not a passage-level authority.

limitations: Best verified in Chinese primary and critical sources; passage-level claims in English translation are not made.
